mapper.select: select child_id as childId, user_id as userId, child_name as childName, birth_year as birthYear from children where child_id = #{childId}
select child_id as childId, user_id as userId, child_name as childName, birth_year as birthYear from children where user_id = #{familyId} order by child_id asc

select child_id as child_id, daily_limit_minutes as daily_limit_minutes, weekday_start_hour as weekday_start_hour, weekday_end_hour as weekday_end_hour, weekend_start_hour as weekend_start_hour, weekend_end_hour as weekend_end_hour, bedtime_lock_enabled as bedtime_lock_enabled, bedtime_hour as bedtime_hour, monday_limit_minutes as monday_limit_minutes, tuesday_limit_minutes as tuesday_limit_minutes, wednesday_limit_minutes as wednesday_limit_minutes, thursday_limit_minutes as thursday_limit_minutes, friday_limit_minutes as friday_limit_minutes, saturday_limit_minutes as saturday_limit_minutes, sunday_limit_minutes as sunday_limit_minutes, notification_threshold as notification_threshold, auto_block_enabled as auto_block_enabled, updated_at as updated_at from child_watch_policy where child_id = #{childId}
mapper.insert: insert into child_watch_policy ( child_id, daily_limit_minutes, weekday_start_hour, weekday_end_hour, weekend_start_hour, weekend_end_hour, bedtime_lock_enabled, bedtime_hour, monday_limit_minutes, tuesday_limit_minutes, wednesday_limit_minutes, thursday_limit_minutes, friday_limit_minutes, saturday_limit_minutes, sunday_limit_minutes, notification_threshold, auto_block_enabled, updated_at ) values ( #{childId}, #{dailyLimitMinutes}, #{weekdayStartHour}, #{weekdayEndHour}, #{weekendStartHour}, #{weekendEndHour}, #{bedtimeLockEnabled}, #{bedtimeHour}, #{mondayLimitMinutes}, #{tuesdayLimitMinutes}, #{wednesdayLimitMinutes}, #{thursdayLimitMinutes}, #{fridayLimitMinutes}, #{saturdayLimitMinutes}, #{sundayLimitMinutes}, #{notificationThreshold}, #{autoBlockEnabled}, current_timestamp ) on conflict (child_id) do update set daily_limit_minutes = excluded.daily_limit_minutes, weekday_start_hour = excluded.weekday_start_hour, weekday_end_hour = excluded.weekday_end_hour, weekend_start_hour = excluded.weekend_start_hour, weekend_end_hour = excluded.weekend_end_hour, bedtime_lock_enabled = excluded.bedtime_lock_enabled, bedtime_hour = excluded.bedtime_hour, monday_limit_minutes = excluded.monday_limit_minutes, tuesday_limit_minutes = excluded.tuesday_limit_minutes, wednesday_limit_minutes = excluded.wednesday_limit_minutes, thursday_limit_minutes = excluded.thursday_limit_minutes, friday_limit_minutes = excluded.friday_limit_minutes, saturday_limit_minutes = excluded.saturday_limit_minutes, sunday_limit_minutes = excluded.sunday_limit_minutes, notification_threshold = excluded.notification_threshold, auto_block_enabled = excluded.auto_block_enabled, updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(watch_duration), 0) / 60 from viewing_history where child_id = #{childId} and date(watch_time) = current_date
select count(*) from viewing_history where user_id = #{familyId} and date(watch_time) = current_date
select count(*) from alert_log a join viewing_history v on v.viewing_id = a.viewing_id where v.user_id = #{familyId}

select a.alert_id as alert_id, a.viewing_id as viewing_id, v.child_id as child_id, c.child_name as child_name, a.alert_type as alert_type, a.risk_level as risk_level, a.message_text as message_text, v.video_id as video_id, v.watch_time as watch_time from alert_log a join viewing_history v on v.viewing_id = a.viewing_id left join children c on c.child_id = v.child_id where v.user_id = #{familyId} order by v.watch_time desc nulls last, a.alert_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into viewing_history ( viewing_id, user_id, child_id, video_id, watch_time, watch_duration ) values ( #{viewingId}, #{userId}, #{childId}, #{videoId}, #{watchTime}, #{watchDuration} )
insert into alert_log ( alert_id, viewing_id, alert_type, risk_level, message_text ) values ( #{alertId}, #{viewingId}, #{alertType}, #{riskLevel}, #{messageText} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from alert_log where lower(risk_level) in ('high', 'critical') or risk_level in ('high-risk', 'danger')
